name: RecordJob
description: An open position: employment type, work mode, location, start and how to apply, plus its own page at /job/<slug> whose body carries the tasks/profile/offer sections.
when_to_use: One record per vacancy. Close a position by deleting or hiding the record rather than editing another one, so its URL stops resolving.
capabilities: employment type (full/part/apprentice/intern/freelance) and work mode (onsite/hybrid/remote) for filtering
location, start date as free text, optional salary range
application by email or external link, link winning when both are set
content_elements: the vacancy body — any active Content Block

ai.prompt_summary: Job record (tx_factorycore_record_job, type slug 'job'): title (required, the position — include (m/w/d) where the client uses it), slug (required, auto from title), excerpt (1-2 sentences for the card), employment_type (full|part|apprentice|intern|freelance), work_mode (onsite|hybrid|remote), location, starts (free text: 'ab sofort' or a date), salary_range (optional), apply_email, apply_link (wins over the email), hero_image, content_elements (the body: tasks, profile, what we offer).
ai.content_guidelines: Match the client's existing (m/w/d) convention rather than introducing one. Never invent a salary range. Put tasks/profile/offer in the BODY as blocks, not crammed into the excerpt.

field_hints.starts: Free text on purpose: 'ab sofort' is as common as a date.
field_hints.apply_link: Takes precedence over apply_email when both are set, so leave it empty if applications go by mail.
field_hints.content_elements: Where the real posting lives — one Text or Section block per part (Aufgaben, Profil, Wir bieten).
